newsitem.title: COMOROS: Three killed in Comoros fighting.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Comoros fighting.

text.p: Three people were killed and several wounded on the Comoros island of Anjouan on Monday in clashes between secessionists and security forces, witnesses said.
Gendarmes, backed by reinforcements flown to Anjouan on a state-owned Aero Comoros plane, set up roadblocks throughout Anjouan and its capital Mutsamudu, witnesses said by telephone.
Government cars were burned in the clashes which started after a large crowd attempted to hoist a French flag on Bastille Day.

Tension has been high on Anjouan after the arrest on Sunday of Charikane Ahmed, 65, a popular secessionist leader. Several people died and many were arrested during clashes between the army and residents last March.

The Comoro Islands archipelago, with a population of 190,000, became independent from France in 1975 but some islanders want to return to the French fold, saying independence has brought only poverty, corruption and political unrest.
